headline: Eighth Day Finds Central Fronts Ablaze, Casualties Soar
war_summary: Since our last edition the war has entered its bloodiest stretch yet. The central corridor burns without pause: the Dead Lands alone have counted over five thousand casualties a side, while Drowned Vale, Endless Shore, Farranac Coast, and Weathered Expanse each report totals running into the thousands, with fresh losses still arriving at hundreds per hour despite a brief cooling in the latest readings. Ownership continues to seesaw. Drowned Vale logged twenty base events in a day, its Wash and Eastmarch posts changing hands repeatedly, and Endless Shore matched that fury with thirty-two events around Woodbind and Wellchurch. Farranac Coast leans Colonial at ten bases to one, yet Warden columns struck back through Palantine Berm and Linn of Mercy, where nine captures were recorded. Fisherman's Row went heavily to the Wardens, while Clahstra and Kings Cage swung Colonial. Tempest Island and Marban Hollow remain open sores, trading posts through the night. Quiet reigns elsewhere — Godcrofts, Mooring County, and their neighbors sit undisturbed behind undisputed flags. Thirty-four victory towns are required for victory; none has fallen.
